name: pCloud
tagline: Secure Swiss cloud storage with lifetime plans and native virtual drive.

instructions.step1: Choose your preferred connection method: OAuth 2.0 (US or EU), WebDAV, or Official App.
instructions.step2: Follow the tailored instructions for your chosen method.
instructions.step3: Your virtual drive will mount immediately at ~/pCloud.

methods.name: OAuth 2.0 (United States)
methods.description: One-click authorization via browser for accounts on the US / Global data center.

instructions.step1: Click 'Sign In via Browser' to launch the secure pCloud authorization window.
instructions.step2: Sign in with your pCloud account and click 'Allow' to grant Ocloud access.
instructions.step3: Your drive mounts natively to ~/pCloud with real-time change notifications.

methods.name: OAuth 2.0 (European Union)
methods.description: One-click authorization for accounts registered in the European Union data center.

instructions.step1: Click 'Sign In via Browser' to launch authorization for the EU gateway (eapi.pcloud.com).
instructions.step2: Sign in with your EU pCloud account and approve access.
instructions.step3: Your drive mounts natively to ~/pCloud connected to the European data center.

methods.name: WebDAV Gateway
methods.description: Mount directly using your pCloud email and password over encrypted WebDAV (US or EU).

instructions.step1: Select your regional WebDAV gateway (webdav.pcloud.com or ewebdav.pcloud.com).
instructions.step2: Enter your pCloud account email and password.

fields.label: pCloud Account Email
fields.helper: The email address associated with your pCloud account

methods.name: Official pCloud Linux App
methods.description: Official pCloud Drive desktop client with local sync and Crypto folder support.

instructions.step1: Download the official pCloud Drive Linux AppImage or install pcloudcc from the AUR.
instructions.step2: Make the AppImage executable: chmod +x pcloud.AppImage && ./pcloud.AppImage
instructions.step3: Log in with your pCloud credentials for native virtual drive and system tray sync.
